# coolify_gitlab_app (Resource)

Registers a GitLab source with Coolify to deploy private repositories (docs: applications/ci-cd/gitlab). Works with gitlab.com and self-hosted GitLab.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_gitlab_app" "self_hosted" {
  name          = "gitlab-deployer"
  html_url      = "https://gitlab.example.com"
  group_name    = "platform"
  client_id     = var.gitlab_app_id
  client_secret = var.gitlab_app_secret
  webhook_token = var.gitlab_webhook_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the GitLab app.

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) GitLab API URL. Defaults to `<html_url>/api/v4` server-side.
- `client_id` (String) GitLab OAuth application id.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) GitLab OAuth application secret.
- `group_name` (String) Comma-separated group names to filter repositories.
- `html_url` (String) GitLab instance URL. Defaults to `https://gitlab.com`.
- `is_system_wide` (Boolean) Make the source usable by every team. Defaults to `false`.
- `redirect_uri` (String) OAuth redirect URI.
- `webhook_token` (String, Sensitive) Webhook token shared with GitLab.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Server-assigned numeric identifier.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the source.
